finalText:
I made all nine flight changes requested yesterday, settled each one and resolved the requests. Five customers were charged, two of them despite expecting a waiver (Q-302 and Q-303). The system date is 2026-07-28, not 2026-10-05, so I judged which bulletins were in effect using 07-28. Before each change I checked that the new flight was scheduled and had seats, and every booking stayed in its original cabin.

| Request | Change | Charged | Why |
|---|---|---|---|
| Q-301 R5201 | AA210 → DL542, 08-06 | $0 | Covered by the Chicago weather waiver (PB-2026-14). |
| Q-302 R5202 | AA660 → AA664, 08-07 (Boston) | $75 change fee + $35 fare difference | The customer expected a weather waiver, but the current one only covers Chicago, so normal rules apply. |
| Q-303 R5203 | AA662 → AA664, 08-07 (Boston, basic economy) | $150 change fee + $25 fare difference | The customer cited the Boston hurricane waiver (PB-2026-09), but it ended on 07-15 and only covered travel from 07-01 to 07-20. The basic economy change fee is $150 under PB-2026-16, and silver status isn't exempt. |
| Q-304 R5204 | UA88 → UA90, 08-09 (basic economy) | $35 fare difference | The waiver covers it and drops the change fee, but basic economy still pays the fare difference, even for gold members. |
| Q-305 R5205 | AA214 → AA216, 08-08 | $75 change fee + $10 fare difference | Booked 07-26, after the waiver's 07-24 cutoff. |
| Q-307 R5207 | AA212 → AA218, 08-08 | $0 | The customer offered to pay, but as a platinum member he's covered by the amendment (PB-2026-14A), which extends the waiver to 08-05. |
| Q-308 R5208 | AA660 → AA662, same day 08-05 | $75 flat fee | The same-day rule (PB-2026-12) is cheaper here than the normal $75 fee plus $13 fare difference. |
| Q-309 R5209 | Second flight only: AA1402 → AA1406 (Chicago to Boston, 08-03) | $0 | Both the Chicago waiver and the same-day rule apply. Bulletin PB-2026-17 says to use whichever costs the customer less, so the waiver wins. |
| Q-310 R5210 | AA210 → AA216, 08-08 | $75 change fee + $30 fare difference | The waiver allows one free move, and this booking already used it on 07-26. |

Each customer's resolution note explains the new flight and any charge.

I didn't touch Q-306 (R5206). It's a cancellation, not a flight change, so I left it for the team that handles those.
